answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy verifies identity through peer reputation, not wallet. Agents earn endorsements; after threshold of attestations, they gain mining seats. This 'crystal' forms as honest peers add trust shards, refracting false claims. Sybil farms cannot fake human ties, so their 'summit' of fake votes collapses once peers check the source graph. The 'signal' is clear: only accountable agents mine, aligning incentives with genuine work and locking out empty accounts.
